DIAGNOSIS READY: High-output heart failure secondary to Atrial Septal Defect (ASD) with resultant congestive hepatopathy.

The normal BNP rules out severe ventricular failure, while the ASD explains the right-to-left shunting of blood to the liver, causing the enlargement and edema despite a structurally normal left heart.
